overall_assessment: UiO extraction is mostly clean for course_content, learning_outcomes and prerequisites (admission boilerplate is correctly dropped). The main weakness is that coursework_requirements is rarely emitted: obligatory activities under 'Undervisning' or 'Eksamen' stay in teaching_methods/assessment. A second problem is a reading_list that swallowed a practice-description block, and assessment padded with exam language/grading-scale logistics.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk aktivitet innleveringssemesteret: For å kunne levere oppgaven må kandidaten fylle inn et opplysningsskjema innen:
findings.description: Obligatory activities and arbeidskrav appear under UiO's 'Undervisning' heading or inside 'Eksamen'. They are approve/fail gates, so the codebook puts them in coursework_requirements. They stay in teaching_methods (HIS4095L, HIS4090L, FYS1120L, PROF3025, NAT5000, NOR4515) or in assessment (KJM5050: 'arbeidskrav i emnet', 75 % approval rule). No coursework_requirements row is emitted for these courses. This is the pre-pass 'leak->coursework_requirements' flag, and it is a real problem.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Section splitting is driven only by top-level UiO headings (Undervisning, Eksamen). Inline sub-headings such as 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter:' and 'Obligatoriske forhold i undervisningen:' are not split out. Paragraphs about obligatory activities are not recognised inside assessment either.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/extract_sections.R, add a second-level split inside teaching_methods and assessment at lines matching 'Obligatoriske? (aktivitet|aktiviteter|forhold|krav)', 'Faglige krav', 'Arbeidskrav' and 'obligatorisk(e) (øvelser|innleveringer)'. Map them to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R, and let the section run to the next heading.

findings.evidence: Gjennomføring av praksis Praksis utgjør 15 dager (120 timer), fordelt på planlegging og gjennomføring - inkludert for- og etterarbeid.
findings.description: The 'Pensum' section (3 sentences) is followed by a free-standing 'Gjennomføring av praksis' block with a 1. FORARBEID / 2. GJENNOMFØRING / 3. ETTERARBEID schedule and teacher assessment criteria. All of it was appended to reading_list (1698 chars). It is teaching/practice description and belongs in teaching_methods and coursework_requirements, not the reading list.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Gjennomføring av praksis' matches no heading pattern, so its text is appended to the previous section (reading_list, from 'Pensum').
findings.suggested_fix: Add a heading pattern '^Gjennomføring av praksis' and 'Praksis' mapped to teaching_methods in R/section_heading_map.R. Also stop the reading_list section at the next unmapped heading when the text is not a literature list.

findings.evidence: Sensurordning: Det er to bedømmelsessensorer på hver eksamensdel. Sensurering: Begge deleksamenene må bestås for å bestå emnet. Det gis en samlet karakter for emnet. Eksamensdel 1 vektes med 60 %, og eksamensdel 2 vektes med 40 %.
findings.description: Under 'Faglige krav for å kunne avlegge eksamen:' the coursework section absorbs the following sub-headings 'Sensurordning:' and 'Sensurering:'. These are assessment content (grading, weights) and not an approval gate. The weighting of exam parts (60/40) is therefore lost from assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-headings with a trailing colon, like 'Sensurering:', map to nothing, so they are appended to the preceding coursework_requirements section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add patterns for '^Sensur(ordning|ering)' mapped to assessment in R/section_heading_map.R, so the coursework section ends there.

findings.evidence: Tysk Emnet bruker karakterskala fra A til F, der A er beste karakter og F er er stryk. Les mer om karakterskalaen.
findings.description: Assessment is padded with the boilerplate fields 'Eksamensspråk' and 'Karakterskala'. In TYSK4091 the bare word 'Tysk' sits in assessment, and in NOR4515 the bare word 'Nynorsk.'. Almost every course also ends with 'Du kan besvare eksamen på norsk, svensk, dansk eller engelsk.' and the grading-scale sentence. HIS4095L adds 'Trykking' (printing copies), cover-page and Inspera logistics. These are exam logistics, not assessment content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Eksamensspråk' and 'Karakterskala' headings are mapped to assessment, or fall through to the previous section. Their values are kept and the heading lines are dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() or the heading map, drop the 'Eksamensspråk', 'Karakterskala', 'Adgang til ny eller utsatt eksamen' and 'Trykking' blocks for uio. Alternatively strip the standard sentences 'Du kan besvare eksamen på norsk, svensk, dansk eller engelsk.' and 'Emnet bruker karakterskala ...' with a regex. Do not let a one-word value like 'Tysk' or 'Nynorsk.' form a block.

findings.evidence: Eksamensdel 1 kan besvares på engelsk for studenter som har engelskdidaktikk som fagdidaktikk A.
findings.description: The 'Hjelpemidler til eksamen' blocks are dropped from the extraction: 'Godkjent kalkulator / Rottmann ...' in FYS1120L, 'Alle hjelpemidler er tillatt' in PROF3025 and 'Ingen hjelpemidler er tillatt.' in NAT5000. Inconsistently, the 'Eksamensspråk' text is kept. Exam aids are logistics, so dropping them is acceptable per the rubric, but the assessment content that was kept is mixed with logistics and the treatment is inconsistent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Hjelpemidler til eksamen' is probably mapped to an ignored section while 'Eksamensspråk' is not. They are treated differently although both are exam logistics.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle both headings the same way: drop them. See the assessment logistics finding.
